(communication 4107/2022)Alleged victims:The authors State party:BelarusDates of communications:15 October 2018 (communication 3693/2019), 5 February 2019 (communication 3967/2021), 17 February 2020 (communication 3976/2021), 14 July 2020 (communication 3994/2021), 12 July 2019 (communication 3995/2021), 5 February 2020 (communication 4020/2021), 7 September 2020 (communication 4042/2021), 18 February 2021 (communication 4101/2022), 18 February 2021 (communication 4102/2022), 16 April 2021 (communication 4107/2022)Substantive issue:Sanctioning for participation in a peaceful protestAt its meeting on 19 July 2024, the Human Rights Committee decided to discontinue consideration of the above communications owing to the loss of contact with the authors.
